item.name: Private Historic Harbor Cruise
item.description:
#Experience the charm of Key West from a unique perspective with our Harbor Cruise. 

##About
Set sail from historic seaports and meander through picturesque harbors, where colorful sailboats and historic landmarks line the waterfront. Take in the sights and sounds of this vibrant coastal town as our experienced captain regales you with tales of its storied past. Whether you're enjoying a romantic sunset cruise or a leisurely daytime excursion, our Harbor Cruise offers a front-row seat to the beauty and charm of Key West – a true maritime adventure not to be missed.

##Extra
All charter passengers may use The Perry Hotel and Marina Pools as my guests before and after the charter. David, Owner
item.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT ACTION REQUIRED
Six Fins Charter – Historic Harbor Cruise Confirmation

Dear Guests,

We’re excited to welcome you aboard your Private Historic Harbor Cruise — a 3-hour exploration of Key West’s storied waterfront from the comfort of your own private charter.

Please review the important details below to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

✅ Before Your Cruise

For trips up to six passengers:

👉 Each passenger must complete the insurance waiver (including adults on behalf of minors): [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/rd9k5tiavpwper7h2rhaqh/web/)

AND for trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

👉 The primary renter (21+ years old) and captain must complete the Bareboat Agreement together at the dock before departure, but prior to arrival, you may begin: [here](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/ez5636zbxexwrng7dtz6mq/web/)

Please complete all required forms before arrival so we may depart on time.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🌊 Your Harbor Experience

This is a private 3-hour cruise through the historic waters of Key West.

Possible scenic routes may include:

• The Historic Seaport District
• Mallory Square waterfront
• Sunset Key
• Wisteria Island
• Naval Air Station waters (as permitted)
• Waterfront estates and harbor anchorages

Your captain will tailor the route based on conditions and your preferences — whether you prefer a history-focused cruise, relaxed sightseeing, wildlife spotting, or a golden-hour harbor experience.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🛥 Departure Details

Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd
Stock Island, FL 33040

Free parking is available adjacent to The Perry Hotel & Marina.
Please arrive 15 minutes prior to departure.

Boat:
30' Jeanneau NC 895 Weekender
Private enclosed head (toilet)
USCG-certified safety equipment
Licensed USCG captains

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🧳 What’s Included

• Cooler with ice
• Bottled water & light snacks
• Comfortable seating
• Local historical narration

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🚫 Not Included

• Meals & beverages (BYOB welcome)
• Towels
• Infant/toddler USCG-approved life jackets (must be provided by guest)
• Captain & crew gratuity (customary 20% minimum if satisfied)

Open flames are not permitted onboard.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🩺 Health & Safety

Your safety is our highest priority.

• Operated by U.S. Coast Guard–licensed captains
• Safety briefing provided before departure
• U.S. Coast Guard–approved life jackets available
• Required safety equipment onboard at all times

• Food allergies or dietary restrictions: reply to this email and let us know in advance so we can prepare.
• Prone to seasickness: tell us ahead of time and we'll suggest what to take before boarding.

While this is generally a calm-water cruise, conditions may vary. The captain reserves the right to adjust the route for safety.

Excessive intoxication or unsafe behavior may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

⚠ Disclaimers

• All itineraries are subject to weather and captain discretion.
• Sunset timing and cloud cover vary daily.
• Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed.
• Late arrivals may reduce charter time without refund.
• Six Fins is not responsible for lost, stolen, or damaged personal items.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🎁 Complimentary Access

As my charter guests, you may enjoy access to The Perry Hotel & Marina pools and fitness center before and after your cruise.

Make it a full island day.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

We look forward to showing you Key West from the water.

Best regards,

David McFadden
Owner, Six Fins Charter
item.cancellation_notes:
Enjoy peace of mind with our cancellation policy:

All reservations made within 7 calendar days of departure are non-refundable. Customer cancellations made prior to 7 calendar days before departure will receive a full refund. If Six Fins Charter cancels due to unsafe weather conditions or other circumstances initiated by the owner/operator, the customer will receive a full refund.
